verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents free custom email on your own domain (Dynadot Email), so the email half is covered, though forwarding is not explicitly named. It also sells DV SSL certificates, but nothing in the evidence says SSL is free or bundled, so the 'costs nothing extra' path is only half supported. Missing for 10: explicit email-forwarding documentation, evidence that SSL is free/bundled with the domain, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the basics are bundled — email forwarding on my domain and free SSL so the parked-to-launched path costs nothing extra

citations.quote: Start your free custom email using your own domain and strengthen your brand identity with Dynadot Email.
Secure your site with trusted 256-bit encryption. Get fast DV (Domain Validation), approval, and protect your website users with 99.9 % browser support.
